# A passage condemned, and why

The withdrawn sentence is still on the [Wi-Fi page](f-wifi.md), struck out and followed by its reason. The
[Bestiary](../bestiary.md) keeps it as a ruled-out lead on the Whisperer's clock front. A closed lead can be reopened
by anyone who finds the old map, which is why the correction stays visible, next to what it corrected.

The Whisperer still keeps its language: which physical gate feeds the coprocessor is not known. Someone after you may
find it, or may show that the question was framed wrongly.

If you notice two sheets that disagree, or a page that says more than its proof, [suggest a correction](https://github.com/SebE585/trognon/issues/new?template=correction.yml). A correction is as welcome as a
discovery. Scout of an inconsistency, archivist of a source, decipherer of a clue, witness of an observation,
cartographer of a correction: which trace would you leave?
